question: At zero parameter drift, what exact ratio and log-probability gap does pinned TRL compute between raw policy p and processed behavior q, and can samples from q recover the raw-policy expectation E_p[R] for every bounded reward when truncation removes part of p's support?

estimands.processed_behavior: q(a|x)=p(a|x) restricted by the configured sampler support and renormalized
estimands.support_condition: Importance sampling can identify E_p[R] for every bounded reward from q samples only if p is absolutely continuous with respect to q; top-p/top-k/min-p truncation violates this when any positive-p action is removed.
estimands.interpretation_boundary: A non-unit p/q ratio on q's support is the exact likelihood ratio for p versus q there; its value alone is not a bug. The counterexample concerns missing support for E_p, not whether the intended training target should instead be q.

parameters.rule: smallest descending prefix whose cumulative raw mass is at least top_p
retain tokens with raw probability at least min_p times the maximum token probability

frozen_exact_inputs.score_function_parameterization: theta adds to the third action's logit at theta=0; reward is 1 only on the third action
frozen_exact_inputs.sequence_case: two conditionally independent decision positions with c1's same frozen distribution and transform at each position

primary_metrics: source per-token ratio p/q on every sampled action
absolute log-probability difference |log p - log q|
raw-policy reward gradient versus the expected source-corrected score-function estimate for the frozen support-omission reward

predictions.truncated_support: for each retained action p/q equals retained raw mass Z; E_q[p/q]=Z<1; unsupported raw-policy outcomes have zero sampling probability
predictions.support_omission_reward: the exact source-corrected sample score-gradient is zero while the raw-policy gradient at theta=0 is p3*(1-p3)>0
predictions.sequence_ratio: for two positions with equal retained mass Z, the source sequence-level ratio is Z^2 before clipping

failure_criteria: any exact metric differs from its frozen prediction
the current pinned source no longer forms the ratio from full-model log-probability minus processed sampler log-probability
the chosen top-p/top-k/min-p rules do not produce the declared support sets
claim_limits: This is exact finite-support analysis of pinned source semantics, not an execution of vLLM or GRPOTrainer.
A support-mismatch counterexample establishes bias for the explicitly named raw-policy estimand; it does not decide which policy distribution a user intends to optimize.
It does not measure real-model learning, task success, GPU behavior, or prevalence in user workloads.
The issue is already reported upstream; no novelty or upstream acceptance is presumed.
